questions.stem: The simple interest accrued on a sum of money at the end of four years is \( \tfrac{1}{5} \) of its principal. What is the rate of interest per annum?
questions.keySolution: SI in 4 years = \( \tfrac{P}{5} \Rightarrow\) total rate for 4 years = \(20\%\). Hence yearly rate = \(\tfrac{20}{4}=5\%\).

questions.stem: A sum of \( \text{Rs.}\,8000 \) is lent at simple interest of \( 10\% \) p.a. What is the interest accrued after \( 3 \) years?
If a sum of money amounts to \( \text{Rs.}\,11{,}000 \) in \( 2 \) years at \( 5\% \) compound interest p.a., what was the principal?
The difference between compound interest and simple interest on \( \text{Rs.}\,10{,}000 \) for \( 2 \) years at \( 10\% \) per annum is:
A sum of money doubles itself in \( 5 \) years at simple interest. Find the annual rate.
questions.keySolution: If amount doubles, SI = P. \( P = \frac{P\times R\times5}{100} \Rightarrow R=20\% \).
